import trimesh, numpy as np
# load print-in-place combined
m = trimesh.load('checks/assembly/print-in-place.stl')
print('pip bounds', m.bounds, 'vol', m.volume)
# slice near z=33 to see profile: section at z=32.9
sec = m.section(plane_origin=[0,0,32.9], plane_normal=[0,0,1])
if sec is not None:
    p,_ = sec.to_planar()
    print('section entities', len(sec.entities), 'verts', len(sec.vertices))
    print('section bounds xyz', sec.bounds)
else:
    print('no section')
# load instances closed
box = trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.d40d2008.stl')
lid = trimesh.load('checks/assembly/model.assembly.80ac5204.stl')
print('box bounds', box.bounds)
print('lid bounds', lid.bounds)
# apply lid rotation 90 about x at (0,-33,30)
th = np.deg2rad(90)
c,s = np.cos(th), np.sin(th)
R = np.array([[1,0,0],[0,c,-s],[0,s,c]])
p0 = np.array([0.,-33.,30.])
def rot(mesh):
    v = np.asarray(mesh.vertices) - p0
    v = v @ R.T
    v = v + p0
    m2 = mesh.copy(); m2.vertices = v
    return m2
lid90 = rot(lid)
print('lid90 bounds', lid90.bounds)
# min distance approx via nearest vertex sampling
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
def min_gap(a,b):
    t = cKDTree(np.asarray(b.vertices))
    d,_ = t.query(np.asarray(a.vertices))
    return d.min()
print('gap box-lid90 approx (vert)', min_gap(box,lid90))
print('gap box-lid closed approx', min_gap(box,lid))
# sample more: face midpoints too
# find verts of lid90 near z=33
v = np.asarray(lid90.vertices)
sel = v[np.abs(v[:,2]-33)<0.6]
print('lid90 verts near z33 count', len(sel))
if len(sel): print('x range', sel[:,0].min(), sel[:,0].max(), 'y range', sel[:,1].min(), sel[:,1].max())
# box verts near hinge
bv = np.asarray(box.vertices)
selb = bv[(np.abs(bv[:,2]-30)<4)&(bv[:,1]<-29)]
print('box hinge verts y range', selb[:,1].min(), selb[:,1].max(), 'z range', selb[:,2].min(), selb[:,2].max())
